title: The Missing Menu
subtitle: Someone stole Pizza Palace's order data. Or did they?
conceptSummary: SELECT * FROM table gets ALL rows and columns from a table — like opening the full file.

dialogue.text: Rookie! First day on the job and we already have a case. Pizza Palace says their order data has gone MISSING.
Don't get too excited, Byte. Half the cases here are just people who forgot to look.
That's why we have our new rookie detective! The data IS in the database. You just need to find it.
I'm on it. Let me look at the orders table.

teachMoment.title: Your First SQL Query
teachMoment.body:
SQL (Structured Query Language) is how you ask a database questions. The most basic question is: 'Show me everything.' In SQL, that looks like:

SELECT * FROM orders

• SELECT = what columns you want (* means ALL)
• FROM = which table to look in

task.instruction: Look at the orders table. Write a SQL query to see ALL the orders. Use SELECT * FROM orders to fetch everything.

hints.text: The magic words are SELECT and FROM. What table do you want to look at?
To see all columns, use * (asterisk). So: SELECT * FROM ...

winDialogue.text: There they are! 20 orders, all present and accounted for. The data was never missing — nobody checked!
Classic. File this under: read the database before panicking.
Wait... look at those 'discount_code' values. Some say SHADOW42. That's... odd.

storyBeat: Case closed: data was there all along. But a mysterious discount code — SHADOW42 — appears on some orders. Who put it there? The investigation begins...
